contract.search: Complete direct evacuation assignments from three seeds; eight surrogate-free exact-score annealing chains, 96 fresh proposals each; up to two complete local rings per excluded key. Fixed initials per family, finite heuristic.
contract.scoringAdapter: capacity [21,21] selects the unchanged traditional word3 candidate pools; actual physical final-key count is separately audited as 20. Freed Q/Z is not an auxiliary key.

independentMemory.formula: M = ordinary_displacement_links + retroflex_links + YW_nonidentity_links + AEO_carriers + nonidentity_final_links + initial_extra_routes + final_extra_routes
independentMemory.scope: common399; normalized written tails with j/q/x/Y-u restored as v; er explicit; iu/ui/un retained
independentMemory.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once. Every additional key within a head/final costs one routing item. Optional aliases included only where authoritative source is supplied.

scope: Actual 21 initial and 20 final physical keys, scored with unchanged traditional candidate pools through the explicit [21,21] canvas adapter. Complete direct evacuation from specified seeds; eight finite exact-score annealing chains and complete recorded local rings. Any reported one-step closure is only for recorded leaders, fixed search policy, fixed initials, and the defined move/swap/whole-group operators; neither exhaustive all-layout search nor closure across all auxiliary policies. Auxiliary policy optimization covers lane finalists only.
